jobs.title: Creative Strategist/ Art Director
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Creative Strategist/ Art Director

Overview

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally. Marketing Services is the team within Services that develops and executes the marketing programs that help our clients achieve their marketing goals. The Advisors Creative Desk (ACD) sits within Services and is responsible for ideating and creating engaging, forward-thinking, on-brand content solutions and campaigns that connect our advertising partners, platforms, and our portfolio of brands.

As a Sr Creative Art based in Milan, you will shape the creative thinking and designs behind our work for the Italian market - turning client business challenges into sharp strategic platforms and bringing them creatively to life as ideas that can be seen, not just read. You will relish a fast-paced environment, juggle multiple deliverables, and be equally comfortable defending a strategic rationale and sketching out how the idea should look and feel.

The Role

Translate client briefs and market insight into compelling creative strategies and campaign platforms for the Italian market, with occasional work across wider Europe
Develop holistic, memorable campaigns from initial concept through to execution - Working closely with Creative Desk Project Managers, Art Directors and Copywriters to ensure end-to-end development and delivery of campaigns for assigned customers.
Maintain quality, accuracy and consistency of content and design across all mediums to best industry practice standards and client branding guidelines by ensuring all output is checked and errors minimised.
Overall responsibility for the production of communications material on time and to budget.
Bring strong conceptual skills and a highly developed ability to express those concepts across a continuously evolving set of channels
Craft short and long form copy in Italian and English for marketing purposes, including direct response designed to drive action and conversion
Think visually: shape look, feel, layout and tone alongside designers and art directors, and communicate ideas through sketches, mood boards, storyboards or scrappy mock-ups where words alone won't land
Execute across a wide array of channels including TV, online video, online banners, social platforms, and print - always to the highest standards of craft
Present work concisely in internal reviews and client meetings, in both Italian and English
Be proactive in bringing ideas that solve client challenges and grow the business

All About You

Native or fully fluent Italian, with proven experience building creative work for the Italian market and a genuine feel for its culture, media landscape and consumer behaviour
Fluent business English - you will work daily with colleagues and clients across Europe
Experience developing creative strategy and concepts within a creative agency environment or client-side marketing team
Ability to concept new campaigns across a variety of mediums, digital-first
Ability to combine conceptual creative thinking with high-quality delivery
A strong visual instinct - you have a point of view on design, typography and imagery
Ability to interpret brand and style guidelines from various clients and apply them consistently across marketing collateral
Ability to interpret creative briefing documents and translate them into compelling, on-strategy work
Captivating presentation skills
Passionate about social platforms, trends, technology and best practices
Excellent organizational and communication skills

A Plus

International or multi-market campaign experience
Experience in financial institutions, banking, payments or wider FI industries
Creative agency background
A solid understanding of the customer journey as it relates to card and banking (acquisition, conversion, activation, early month on books, customer loyalty, cross-sell)
A portfolio that shows both the thinking and the making - strategy decks alongside work you helped shape visually

Gross annual salary base range: 45,000 - 72,000 EUR

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Where applicable, additional information for positions located in Europe, including benefits, variable pay, and other disclosures, is available at https://careers.mastercard.com/us/en/disclosures. Candidates should review this information as part of the application process.

Creative Operations Lead – Future is Now

Future is Now olarak; yapay zeka odaklı pazarlama, marka danışmanlığı, yaratıcı üretim ve dijital teknoloji çözümleri geliştiriyoruz. Markaların pazarlama iletişimini, kampanya üretimini, görsel dünyasını ve iş süreçlerini yapay zeka destekli sistemlerle güçlendiriyoruz.
AI-powered marketing, generative AI üretim, marka iletişimi, içerik üretimi, kreatif teknoloji ve kurumsal yapay zeka çözümleri alanlarında çalışan ekibimize müşteri, kreatif ekip ve üretim arasındaki süreci uçtan uca sahiplenecek bir Creative Operations Lead arıyoruz.

Tercihen 7+ yıl kreatif, prodüksiyon, marka iletişimi veya proje yönetimi alanında deneyime sahip,
Müşteri yönetiminde deneyimli, kreatif projeleri brief’ten teslimata kadar yönetmiş,
Tasarım, video, içerik ve prodüksiyon süreçlerinin nasıl çalıştığına hakim,
Müşteri ihtiyacını yaratıcı ve uygulanabilir bir çözüme dönüştürebilen,
ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini gibi araçları aktif kullanan, Seedance, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield gibi yeni nesil üretim araçlarına açık,
Yüksek kalite standardına ve güçlü problem çözme becerisine sahip,
İstanbul’da hibrit çalışmaya uygun adaylarla tanışmak istiyoruz.

Görev Tanımı

Müşteri toplantılarına katılmak, projenin kapsamını, üretim yöntemini ve zaman planını belirlemek,
Brief’i güçlü bir kreatif yaklaşıma çevirmek ve doğru üretim modelini kurgulamak,
Tasarım, video, içerik ve AI destekli projelerde prodüksiyon sürecini baştan sona yönetmek,
Ekibin ürettiği işlerde kalite kontrolü sağlamak ve brand consistency’yi korumak,
Aynı anda ilerleyen farklı müşteri ve projelerin genel kontrolünü yürütmek, deadline ve kaynakları yönetmek,
Kreatif, tasarım, video ve prodüksiyon ekipleri arasındaki iş akışını koordine etmek; gerektiğinde tasarım, kurgu veya içerik üretim sürecine dahil olmak.

Stratejiden prodüksiyona kadar sürecin her aşamasında karar alan, kreatif yönü belirleyen bir pozisyon,

Mutabor
ist die größte unabhängige internationale Markenagentur, die in Deutschland gegründet wurde. Die Inhaber, Johannes Plass und Heinrich Paravicini, sind bis heute Teil der 6-köpfigen Geschäftsführung.

200 + Creative Consultants in Hamburg, Berlin und Los Angeles schaffen wirkungsvolle Lösungen, die auf ganzheitlichen Strategien, großartigem Design und modernster Technologie basieren.

Unter dem Leitmotiv »Brand Intelligence® unterstützt Mutabor Marken dabei, nicht nur relevant, sondern resilient und zukunftsfähig zu werden. Die Dienstleistungen umfassen u.a.: strategische Beratung, Gestaltung und adaptive Designsysteme inklusive Packaging, Live- und Digital Experience, Kommunikation sowie Brand Management.
Zu den Kund:innen gehören u.a. BMW-Motorrad, BRENNTAG, Clariant, GEA, die DFL, Henkel, HelleniQ Energy, Kleinanzeigen, Migros, OTTO, Pfizer, Porsche, Veltins und Volkswagen.

Mutabor ist der lateinische Ausdruck für den Willen zur Veränderung (ich werde verwandelt werden – i'm going to change). Dieser Wille treibt Mutabor seit der Gründung 1998 an. Mit über 700 Awards, unzähligen Projekten für Kund:innen fast aller Branchen – von Start-ups bis zu internationalen Konzernen – gehört Mutabor heute zu den größten unabhängigen Agenturen der Kreativbranche in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Senior Creative Strategist (f/m/d) bei Mutabor Advertising bist du die strategische Instanz im Team: Du entwickelst eigenverantwortlich Kampagnenstrategien und Markenpositionierungen, gibst der Kreation die richtigen Sprungbretter und bringst Kund:innen auf Entscheider:innen-Ebene klare strategische Orientierung. Du übernimmst Projekte von Anfang bis Ende - von der Analyse über die Konzeption bis zur Präsentation. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kreation und Beratung zusammen und wirkst punktuell auch bereichsübergreifend mit Expert:innen aus Brand Design, UX/UI Design, Motion Design und Architektur.
Du verantwortest und entwickelst eigenständig Kampagnenstrategien, Markenpositionierungen und zielgruppenspezifische Kommunikationsframeworks - von der Analyse bis zur Präsentation.
Du führst tiefgehende Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Zielgruppenanalysen durch und leitest daraus klare, überzeugende strategische Empfehlungen ab.
Du übersetzt Daten, Recherchen und kulturelle Beobachtungen in umsetzbare Strategien und kreative Leitideen, die der Kreation echten Auftrieb geben.
Du planst und moderierst Kund:innenworkshops und -präsentationen und führst diese souverän durch.
Du bringst dich aktiv in New-Business-Initiativen ein - von der Konzeption bis zur Präsentation.
Du behältst den Überblick über strategische Projektprozesse, sorgst für Transparenz gegenüber allen Stakeholder:innen und steuerst (Teil-)Projekte eigenverantwortlich.
Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsmethoden, Tools und Prozessen im Strategiebereich voran und gibst dein Wissen an Kolleg:innen in deinem Team weiter.

Deine Qualifikationen

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Kommunikationswissenschaft, Marketing, BWL, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Kommunikations- oder Markenstrategie-Agentur mit.
Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Führung von Strategie-Projekten und im direkten Kund:innenkontakt.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, formulierst komplexe Inhalte klar und verständlich und erstellst überzeugende Präsentationen, die Wirkung entfalten.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office – insbesondere PowerPoint – sowie Erfahrung mit strategischen Research-Tools wie Statista oder best4planning.
Du erkennst Potenziale frühzeitig, bringst proaktiv Impulse ein und gibst strategische Impulse sowohl nach innen als auch nach außen.
Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für (unterhaltsame) Werbung, kulturelle Trends und kommunikationswirksame Ideen.

Wir bieten

Sei Teil der kreativsten Designagentur Deutschlands.
Hier findest du den Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit in einem interdisziplinären Team. Von Corporate Design, UX-UI-Design über Architektur bis hin zu Motion Design - für jeden Kopf finden wir den richtigen Hut.

who will produce high-quality visual creatives
with the primary goal of improving conversion rates
. AI Visual Production:

Create high-quality AI-generated visuals for performance marketing campaigns across paid media channels and landing pages.

Proactive mindset - suggesting improvements, not just executing tasks.

Location: Barcelona

About Us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.
We bridge digital and creative thinking, developing innovative work across skincare, healthcare, fashion, lifestyle, FMCG, and more. Our international teams in the US and Barcelona deliver results through smart strategy, sharp creativity, and meticulous execution.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Creative Director with strong conceptual thinking, great visual taste and experience working across global wellness and lifestyle brands.
Someone who can move comfortably between product and lifestyle, science and culture, and who understands how creative needs to work across the full consumer journey.
You might be working on a product with a complex ingredient or efficacy story one day, developing a talent-led campaign the next, and figuring out how that same brand idea translates into more product-focused or conversion-driven work further down the funnel.
This is a global role, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable developing ideas that can travel across markets and cultures without becoming generic.
You’ll lead creative development across global wellness, beauty-adjacent and lifestyle brands, from early concepts and campaign platforms through to production and execution.
We’re looking for someone who cares about the idea as much as the craft, but also understands what the creative is there to do.
You’ll work hand in hand with Strategy, as well as Copy, Design, Social and Production, to understand the audience, cultural context, role of each channel and each stage of the funnel, and translate that thinking into strong creative.
This isn’t purely an art direction role. You need to be able to come up with strong campaign ideas, build on other people’s ideas and turn them into something bigger.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong global campaign ideas and creative platforms that can live across markets, channels and executions.
Partner closely with strategists from the beginning of the process, challenging and building on briefs rather than simply receiving them.
Understand the role creative plays across the full funnel, from building awareness and brand desire to communicating product benefits, driving consideration and supporting conversion.
Know when an execution needs to build the brand, when it needs to explain the product and when it simply needs to make someone want it.
Turn strategy, product benefits and consumer insights into simple, relevant creative ideas.
Build global creative platforms that have a clear central idea while leaving enough room for markets to make them culturally relevant.
Lead the visual direction of brands across product, lifestyle, talent and culture-led work.
Find interesting ways to communicate ingredients, efficacy, innovation and science without everything suddenly looking clinical.
Make products feel desirable through photography, film, CGI, design, casting, styling and storytelling.
Bring product and lifestyle together naturally, rather than creating a beautiful lifestyle campaign and remembering the product at the end.
Develop ideas around talent, creators, partnerships and cultural moments that make sense for the brand and the market.
Think beyond traditional campaign formats and identify opportunities across social, experiences, collaborations, entertainment and emerging culture.
Lead work from concept through production, keeping the original idea and level of craft intact along the way.
Present and sell creative thinking to senior clients and stakeholders across different markets.
Lead and develop multidisciplinary and international creative teams.

What we’re looking for

A Creative Director who is conceptually strong and visually sophisticated, with a portfolio that shows range.
Big campaign thinking
Ideas with a clear point of view that can become genuine global platforms, not just a collection of executions.
Strong visual taste
A great eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and contemporary brand aesthetics.
Product storytelling
Experience making products, ingredients, technology or benefits interesting and desirable, especially when there’s real science or efficacy behind them.
Full-funnel creative thinking
An understanding of how people move from discovering a brand to considering and buying it, and how the creative job changes along the way.
Strong creative + strategy partnership
Someone who likes working closely with strategists, has a point of view on the brief and knows how to turn strategic thinking into creative opportunities.
Global thinking
Experience developing work for multiple markets and understanding the difference between a global idea and simply making the same campaign appear everywhere. You should be comfortable collaborating with local teams and adapting ideas around different cultural behaviors and audiences without losing the core creative thought.
Lifestyle and culture
Work that shows an understanding of how brands can play in culture through talent, creators, collaborations, social, entertainment and experiences.
Range
We want someone who can create a beautiful product or efficacy story and then switch gears into a culturally relevant lifestyle campaign without either feeling forced.

Key Requirements

10+ years of creative experience, ideally across agencies and/or ambitious consumer brands.
Significant experience working on global brands and international campaigns.
Experience leading integrated and full-funnel campaigns, from brand-building through product and conversion-focused creative.
Background in wellness, beauty, personal care, lifestyle, premium CPG or adjacent categories.
Experience working closely with Strategy on audiences, consumer journeys, cultural insights and creative briefs.
Experience working with product claims, ingredients, efficacy or science-led briefs is a plus.
Strong photography and film production experience.
Experience working with talent, creators or culturally driven campaigns.
Experience leading multidisciplinary and international creative teams.
Excellent client-facing and presentation skills.
Native or near-native English, or equivalent professional fluency developed through extensive experience working in English. This person needs to be able to concept, debate, present and sell creative ideas confidently in English with senior global clients and teams.

Portfolio

We want to see ideas, taste and range.
Showcase strong campaigns, as well as activations, social ideas, collaborations and product experiences that demonstrate different ways brands can connect with people.
We want to see work that feels relevant to its audience, where the product matters and the visual execution is strong.

Languages

English (mandatory)
Spanish (preferably)
Any other languages are a plus.

What we offer

Remote flex Fridays from 9:00 AM to 2.30 PM.
Three weeks of remote work per year.
Summer working hours across July and August (9:00 AM to 4.00 PM).
Free English & Spanish classes to boost your global communication skills.
Access to Wellhub, a wellness platform offering a wide range of fitness and wellbeing options.
Flexible retribution plan for meals, transport and childcare.
Holidays: 22 working days + 3 days established by the collective agreement + national and local public holidays.
Bright, spacious offices in the heart of Barcelona.
Competitive salary with real growth opportunities.
A global environment, cutting-edge tools, and a culture driven by trends and innovation.

At Dragons Group, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and strive to build an environment where every individual feels empowered and respected.

new_jobs.description:
Are you an AI Strategist
expert in specialized models, client workshops & AI solutions grounded in real data
?
Join Reply
!

WHO WE ARE

Reply is a network of highly specialized companies which support leading industrial groups in defining and developing business models using new technology and communication paradigms, such as Big Data, Cloud Computing, Digital Communication, Internet of Things, Mobile and Social Networking. Reply focuses on Consultancy, System Integration and Application Management, covering three areas of competence: Processes, Applications and Technologies.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND

Core activities
. You will interview client stakeholders, run structured workshops, and translate business priorities into concrete AI use cases. You will collect functional and technical requirements, assess where relevant data sits and how ready it is for model development, and determine whether a specialized generative model is needed and how it should be developed through the Reply Model Factory across training, pretraining, or post-training paths.
Tech & tools stack.
You will work across the lifecycle of specialized Generative AI solutions, from use-case framing and model strategy to dataset definition, experimentation, evaluation, and model adaptation. You will collaborate with teams working on foundation models, pretraining, training, and post-training workflows, evaluation frameworks, cloud environments, and the Reply Model Factory to shape scalable, production-minded AI solutions.
Mentoring, collaboration, and continuous growth.
You will work closely with client stakeholders, strategists, designers, data scientists, and engineers in cross-functional teams, combining business understanding with technical judgment. We value structured collaboration, clear communication, and continuous learning, including access to the MIT xPRO course Designing and Building AI Products and Services.

WHAT WE OFFER

An offer tailored to your experience
. This position is open to people with varying levels of expertise and seniority. The compensation package will be determined based on your professional background, technical skills, expertise, and the level of responsibility associated with the role. The collective labour agreement (CCNL) applied is the Italian Metalworking Industry Agreement. The job classification will be assessed starting from level B2 , and the gross annual salary (RAL) will range from €37,000 to €65,000. Previous experience with the training, fine-tuning, and optimization of Foundation Models, LLMs, and custom models for specific domains is considered a strong asset, along with hands-on exposure to cutting-edge technologies such as Agentic AI, Physical AI, and High Performance Computing.
A structured career path
. Our Career Path offers opportunities to grow both as a technical specialist and as a future leader. Your ambitions, the skills you develop, and the results you achieve will shape your professional journey.
Continuous learning
. Technology evolves rapidly - and so do we. You will join an environment that encourages curiosity, continuous learning, and the exploration of new ideas and emerging technologies.
The benefits of being a Replyer
. You will also have access to the benefits and initiatives dedicated to our community.

WHAT WE NEED

Academic background
. We are looking for candidates with a degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Management Engineering, Design, Innovation, or related fields. An interdisciplinary mindset across strategy, technology, and solution design is essential.
Technical & strategic skills
.
You should have from 3 to 8 years of proven experience in AI strategy and in the design of AI solutions, especially Generative AI solutions aimed at specialized models. Experience in stakeholder interviews, workshop facilitation, and functional and technical requirements gathering is essential, together with the ability to assess data availability, data quality, and data readiness for training, pretraining, and post-training initiatives through the Reply Model Factory.
Soft skills
. You should be able to structure ambiguity, ask the right questions, and connect business goals with technical choices. Strong facilitation, synthesis, stakeholder management, and client communication skills are essential, together with curiosity, ownership, and a collaborative mindset.
Nice to have
. Experience with dataset design, model evaluation, data governance, AI product discovery, or enterprise AI transformation is a plus. Exposure to consulting environments, pre-sales, or the definition of AI roadmaps and adoption plans is also appreciated.

WHAT ARE THE NEXT STEPS

The first step of our recruiting process will be the meetings with the technical referents and then a face to face interview with the HR team. We care about an equal recruiting process.

Feel interested?

Reply is committed to embracing diversity and creating an inclusive work environment by valuing the uniqueness of people regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, or disabilities as protected by Italian Law (L.68/99).
Furthermore, Reply is committed to ensuring a fair and accessible selection process: to help you during the recruitment process, please let us know of any kind of support you may need.
